versions.changelog:
Version 1.0.1 — No functional changes; documentation refresh.

- Updated SKILL.md with clarified and expanded instructions.
- No code or logic changes were detected.
- Project usage, workflow, and configuration details clarified in documentation.

Initial release. A fully interactive Chinese detective mystery game with LLM-generated cases, multi-suspect interrogation, and a 100-point scoring system. Supports TTS for multi-character voices, optional ASR for voice input, save/load progress, difficulty levels, and automatic case logic validation.
